interpretation: Development-set comparison only. Kriti checkpoint 49,000 was selected on this same view, while public checkpoints were not; the ranking is therefore useful for model selection and domain comparison but is selection-biased in Kriti's favor. It is not a repeated protected-test result or a world-best claim. Public model cards do not consistently disclose example-level training membership for the source corpora in this view, so public-checkpoint overlap with evaluation examples cannot be ruled out.

prediction_audit.redaction: aggregate counts and ratios only; no transcripts or sample identifiers

ranking.display_name: Conformer-CTC Hindi to Nepali (Paudel et al.)

redaction: aggregate metrics and public model metadata only; no transcripts, sample IDs, audio paths, prediction rows, credentials, endpoint URLs, or model files

scope.definition: Major means an official multilingual family with explicit Nepali support, a public Nepali ASR repository with at least 40 monthly downloads in the authenticated Hugging Face discovery inventory, or a checkpoint in the documented controlled six-model Nepali comparison. Distinct official decoders are separate systems; conversion-only duplicates and unvalidated low-use hobby checkpoints are excluded.
